The change that stopped the redundant query is PR #6346, merged 2026-07-17 as commit `c21a7cbfa2c9f67c1991372a343217e949e04f44`, titled "TRUNK-6683: Skip full-text search with drugs when a concept is provided". Its PR body says it restores the pre-2.8.x behaviour, which it describes as a modest performance boost.

The fix is in `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/db/hibernate/HibernateConceptDAO.java`, in `newDrugQuery` at lines 1582–1583. The ConceptName full-text search now runs only when `searchDrugConceptNames && concept == null`. A comment on line 1582 explains that the search is skipped when a concept is supplied. When a concept is given, the query relies on the existing `concept.conceptId` clause at lines 1601–1603 instead of the ConceptName search results.

The public entry point `ConceptService.getDrugs(String, Concept, boolean, boolean, boolean, Integer, Integer)` is declared in `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/ConceptService.java` (line 1686). `ConceptServiceImpl.java` (lines 1579–1581) passes its arguments straight through to the DAO, so the change needed no edit there. The PR also adds 33 lines of tests to `openmrs-core/api/src/test/java/org/openmrs/api/db/hibernate/HibernateConceptDAOTest.java` and 5 lines of fixture data to `HibernateConceptTestDataSet.xml`. I did not open the test bodies.

Falkon links the PR to TRUNK-5111 through a ticket pattern as well, but the PR title and body name TRUNK-6683 as the ticket it fixes.
